the default stays offline and deterministic, and an unavailable CI source is reported as unavailable, never as failure or success
observations stay separate from recorded state (PLAN-021) and never rewrite it
the observation inputs are included in the plan's input fingerprint

a pair of items whose declared areas or checkpoint-changed paths touch a historically conflicting path gets an 'elevated' collision reason naming the evidence, never 'safe'
the evidence is part of the collision-graph fingerprint

reuseInventory.reason: CI evidence already has a typed observation; the new port only produces values of it.
Resolves CI dependencies from observations; unchanged, so observed and supplied CI behave identically.
The CI port is added as one more observation source on the same read port; it must stay opt-in, so it is a separate field rather than folded into the Git source.
Historical merge-conflict paths are read with the same read-only Git helper next to the existing Git observations.
Read-only Git query helper with typed failures.
Supplied observations keep their contract; observed CI is rendered with the same observation fields.
Every observation is already part of the input fingerprint, so observed CI is fingerprinted with no new code.
A historical-conflict signal is one more CollisionSignal case raising the pair to elevated; the risk ordering and scheduling policies stay unchanged.
Signals are fingerprinted by code and detail, so the new signal enters the collision fingerprint automatically.
Cost prediction follows the same no-hindsight training filter as duration prediction.
Per-execution monetary totals and the minimum-sample rule are taken from the existing cost evidence rules, not re-derived.
The recommendation-outcome comparison is computed from the same previous/current snapshots freshness already diffs.

reuseInventory.element: PlanCommands option parsing and replay/freshness verbs
reuseInventory.reason: New flags (--observe-ci, --record) are added to the existing verbs; no new verb.

newAbstractions.name: CI observation port (opt-in) producing ContinuousIntegrationPassed/Failed
newAbstractions.whyNotReused: That source is offline Git and always on; CI needs a network query that must stay opt-in so the default plan remains deterministic and offline.

newAbstractions.name: praxis.plan-calibration/1 history file
newAbstractions.whyNotReused: Telemetry records are per execution and the group store is owned by the group commands (PRAXIS-GROUP-08 is changing it); calibration is per planner run, so it gets its own append-only file read by one parser.
